output:
  pdf_document: default
  word_document:
    reference_docx: participant_report.docx
  html_document:
    df_print: paged
---
```{r setup_opts, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r}
txt = participant_report$reporttext
partitable = participant_report$partitable
id_i = partitable$id[i]
name = paste0("**", partitable$name[i], "**")
thanks = gsub("r name", name, txt[["thanks"]], fixed = TRUE)
item_cols = grep("^item_", names(partitable), value = TRUE)
your_items = sort(as.vector(unlist(partitable[i, item_cols])))
your_ranking = as.vector(unlist(partitable[i, grep("^Position", names(partitable))]))
yourpackage = paste(paste(your_items, paste0("(Option ", LETTERS[seq_along(your_items)], ")")), collapse = ", ")
firstparagraph = gsub("r yourpackage", yourpackage, txt[["firstparagraph"]], fixed = TRUE)

# the podium with the ranking of this participant
podium_i = participant_report$podium +
  annotate("text", 2, 2, label = your_ranking[1]) +
  annotate("text", 1, 1, label = your_ranking[2]) +
  annotate("text", 3, 0.5, label = your_ranking[3])

has_other_traits = length(rank_dat$trait_list) > 1 &&
  i <= length(participant_report$other_traits_table) &&
  is_plot(participant_report$other_traits_table[[i]])
```

# `r txt[["title"]]`

`r thanks`

`r firstparagraph`

```{r, fig.width=4, fig.height=1, dpi=200}
podium_i
```

`r txt[["overallreply"]]`

```{r, fig.width=4, fig.height=2, dpi=200}

```

`r if (has_other_traits) txt[["othertraits"]] else ""`
